subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Is the latest legacy-upgrade proof summary enough to waive the external real-behavior proof ask, or should the contributor provide raw redacted latest-head output for the pre-code SQLite row and Gateway/startup rederive path?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but ClawSweeper's external PR proof gate needs observed after-fix behavior for the compatibility-sensitive persisted-state upgrade path unless a maintainer explicitly accepts the summarized proof.

options.title: Require Latest-Head Legacy Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing the no-code SQLite diagnostic row, derived registry result, and startup path on the current PR head.

options.title: Accept The Supplied Summary
options.body: Treat the PR-body table and script description as sufficient proof, while explicitly waiving the stronger external proof ask for this upgrade path.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup Out Of Runtime
options.body: Pause the legacy no-code branch and require a doctor or migration-owned cleanup if maintainers do not want runtime invalidation for those rows.

recommendation.title: Require Latest-Head Legacy Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, copied live output, logs, or a linked artifact showing the no-code SQLite diagnostic row, derived registry result, and startup path on the current PR head.
